findings.title: REVIEW holds carry no reason: infrastructure holds cannot be separated from policy holds (no outage signature found)
findings.evidence: 291/291 REVIEW tool errors are the identical string 'ubag-blocked: REVIEW'; the gate's 'failing closed' reason and the behavioural score are not logged. 0 logs where every tool message is REVIEW; REVIEW in 49 of 73 ten-minute blocks (max 22); concentrated on grant-required tools (create_calendar_event 146, send_money 45, update_password 44). Decisions mapped deny, class I, 109/109 in the sample.
